pre_registered_design.design_source: experiments/lead_review/q3/v3_diagnosis.md (coverage diagnostic run on the pre-registered validation folds; no gate-outcome-driven selection)
pre_registered_design.parameter_search: none: interior_fraction=0.50 is a fixed design constant, not selected by evaluating candidate weights on the gate; only the single pre-registered configuration is reported by the gate

coverage_diagnosis: experiments/lead_review/q3/v3_diagnosis.md shows that an oracle generator whose sample set equals the style's training spectra covers only 0.75 (Kriek) / 0.7222 (Lambic) of the held-out spectra, i.e. a support-faithful generator cannot satisfy the pre-registered coverage rules; the interpolation baseline passes them through under-dispersion (variance_ratio 0.72599). v3 is the pre-registered mixture response and does not modify the rules, the baseline or the evaluation code.
cap_convention: log10 fields cap at log10(cap_fraction*threshold); identity fields at cap_fraction*threshold

not_capped.X.E..2.nonenal: no threshold in 8.xlsx (field_name_R X.E..2.nonenal has NaN threshold)

replacement_rule: Replace interpolation only if copula mean held-out marginal W1 and energy are both no higher, each style mean energy no more than 10% worse, each style held-out coverage drop <=0.05, mean variance ratio in [0.8,1.2], mean rank-correlation RMSE <= interpolation+0.05, exact training-copy rate no higher, and mean model-consistent raw-median sensory W1 <= interpolation+0.02. Otherwise retain interpolation and its diagnosed weaknesses. No post-result retuning.
replacement_rules_machine_checkable: mean model-consistent raw-median sensory W1 <= baseline + 0.02

diagnostic_definitions.spectrum_diagnostics: beer_models.q3_raw.spectrum_diagnostics, applied in StyleGenerator robust_ z-space
diagnostic_definitions.sensory_validation: equivalent of scripts/task4_raw_q3.py::sensory_validation, mean model-consistent raw-median W1
diagnostic_definitions.quality_by_style: computed on the delivered 100/style spectra in global median/IQR standardized space
